5.    INSPECT CRANKSHAFT POSITION SENSOR
(a)    Remove the No.2 air tube for the CAC.
(b)    Disconnect the crankshaft position sensor connector.
(c)    Using an ohmmeter, measure the resistance between ter-
minals.
Resistance:

Cold    835 - 1,400 Ω
Hot    1,060 - 1,645 Ω

If the resistance is not as specified, replace the sensor.
(d)    Reconnect the crankshaft position sensor connector.
(e)    Reinstall the No.2 air tube for the CAC.
